notes.text: Available in cPanel 94 and later. Operates on the selected account. The documented workflow starts a scan, polls getScanStatus until complete, lists infected files, lets the user choose each action, queues JSON disinfection and polls checkDisinfectionStatus. This client does not start or poll automatically. Typed disinfectFiles support is excluded pending typed JSON-body support under whm-api-client-8x0.1.18.

Omit lastId to return the entire disinfection log; supplying the last received record ID returns only subsequent records and is recommended for polling performance. The source specifies an integer minimum of 1; values are forwarded without client-side range enforcement.

details preserves step, issue and done record fields: optional file, numeric id, message and state, with type required in every alternative. The pinned step/issue alternatives require state, while done requires only type. Existing object-union merging preserves all fields and common requiredness; it does not enforce a discriminator-dependent state rule. Numeric IDs may be integers or fractional numbers.

The status prose lists done, none, queued and running, while its formal enum lists done, queued and running. Keep the string contract without inventing a closed runtime enum. log is the disinfection log path; results do not initiate disinfection or fetch any file.

The corrected capture at aee24c1081727cd66b8ef86aced5bd27d7e83375 records named id and message string fields in list items on both routes. Preserve the pinned object alternative and the reviewed list of optional id/message records. These observations establish neither every scan type nor record counts; null and missing payloads remain invalid.

Pinned /ClamScanner/get_scan_paths/get/responses/200/content/application~1json/schema/properties/result/properties/data is an object with optional id and message strings. current_file is the current path and infected_files is a string list. scan_complete remains integer 0/1. scanned_file_count and total_file_count count files; scanned_file_size is bytes and total_file_size_MiB is the separately named total megabyte quantity. time_started is an epoch timestamp string, not an integer. Preserve omission separately from zero, empty lists and empty strings.

The initial 2026-10-31 capture returned explicit null data with API success on both routes. Preserve null separately from the documented status object and an absent payload. The capture establishes no reason for null, scan state or completion behavior; no scan was started.

On 11.138.0.19, time_started was an integer through both routes after a startScan() attempt, including a failed attempt while ClamAV was absent. Preserve int|string losslessly; strings are not parsed or narrowed to float. The other seven fields retain their pinned types. A status record does not establish that a scan completed.

scanType is required: home scans the entire account home, mail the email directory, public_html the web directory and public_ftp the FTP directory. Availability depends on administrator configuration. Starts scanner work immediately; the source declares no rollback and the client neither retries nor rolls back.

Returns a nullable object without pinned fields. Preserve opaque fields and explicit null; an absent data member is a payload mismatch. No task ID or successful scan completion is inferred from this result.

On the reviewed 11.138.0.19 server, startScan() failed because the ClamAV plugin was not installed. The attempt could still leave a getScanStatus() record. This server-state limitation establishes no completed scan and does not change API-error handling or authorize an automatic retry.

evidence.note: Pinned /ClamScanner/start_scan GET declares x-readonly=false. Use form POST because this starts scanner work and x-rollback=none. Preserve the inline response schema, required fields, nullable data and exact scalar units/types; infer no response list from a plural operation name.

Reviewer 5720388941 reports startScan failure due to absent ClamAV on this server, with no completed scan. Scan-status records can remain after a failed attempt; this is state evidence, not a universal version restriction.

exclude.reason: Requires an application/json request body with a dynamic actions object mapping infected-file paths to disinfection choices; typed JSON-body support remains tracked under whm-api-client-8x0.1.18. Raw callJson() supplies no typed contract and establishes no endpoint compatibility. This operation is not deprecated.

evidence.note: Pinned /ClamScanner/disinfect_files POST requestBody/content/application~1json/schema/properties/actions is an object whose additionalProperties enum is cleanse_mailbox, delete, quarantine or ignore. The property names are absolute or account-home-relative file paths. x-readonly=false and x-rollback=none; preserve the JSON transport exclusion rather than inventing a scalar form serialization.
